tasks.short: Investigate customer problems referred by support.

steps.what: Take customer problems referred by technical support.
Investigate the problem on a copy of the build.
Draft a cause that quotes only the notes and the log.

loop.input: the notes and the log lines the tester kept
loop.output: a cause note that quotes only those lines
loop.check: every quoted line must be in the notes or the log; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; an unexplained step is left blank
loop.why_not_simpler: what support should tell the customer is the later decision

steps.what: Decide the cause and what support should reply.
Send the finding back to technical support.

tasks.design: The ticket arrives from {HELPDESK}. The tester investigates on a copy of the build. A cause note is kept only when it quotes the notes or the log. The tester decides what support should reply. That finding goes back. The customer's own data is not copied into a new store.
tasks.previous_blocker: Support tickets were forwarded as mail, and the investigation was not tied to the ticket.
tasks.enabler_now: A ticket id and a build are fields. The cause of a customer's problem is not.
tasks.still_hard: A problem that appears only on the customer's data, which the tester cannot copy, stays hard.
tasks.human_edge: The tester can separate a product fault from a setup the customer made.
tasks.altitude: Fetching the ticket takes less time. The investigation and the reply stay.

reach.task: Reply to the customer from the finding
reach.learn: What was ruled out, and what remains

evidence.claim: Linking a finding to a ticket id is a record. Investigating the problem is not.
A support ticket can name a person. The source pack names staff-data rules for some firms. Other countries differ. The finding should not copy the customer's private data.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester investigates and decides the reply. Support talks to the customer. Fixing the product is the developer.
Structured input: ticket id, build, steps, log lines the tester kept. Producer is the ticket and the tester. A cause line that was not recorded is discarded.
Investigation time stays. Customer content is read for the ticket and not reused.
unknowns: Can the tester obtain the build the customer ran?
What customer data may be copied?
research_questions: How often does support get no written finding?

already_counted.description: The investigation is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire findings after the ticket is closed.

approvals.approved_version: reply decision the tester made for that ticket

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the ticket has no build, the fetch still helps and the investigation starts from a question. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review software documentation for accuracy and risks.

steps.what: Review the software documentation against the build.
List gaps in technical accuracy or completeness.
Draft comments that quote the section and the build.

loop.input: the gap list: section id and what the tester wrote
loop.output: comments that cite only those section ids
loop.check: every comment names a section from the list; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a section with no note is skipped
loop.why_not_simpler: whether the risk matters is the review

steps.what: Decide accuracy, compliance and the risks.
File the review comments on the documentation.

tasks.design: The tester reviews the documentation against the build. Gaps in accuracy or completeness are listed from that review. Comments may cite only those sections. The tester decides the risks. The file follows. A comment is not a rewrite of the manual.
tasks.previous_blocker: Documentation drifted, and a wrong step was found by a user.
tasks.enabler_now: A section id and a note are fields. Whether a gap is a real risk is not.
tasks.still_hard: A missing warning that would hurt a user stays a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester has run the steps and knows which sentence is wrong.
tasks.altitude: Listing the gaps takes less time. The review and the risk decision stay.

reach.task: Correct the section the tester marked

evidence.claim: A comment tied to a section id can be checked. Judging the risk cannot.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester reviews and decides the risk. The author changes the document. Release standards are a different task.
Structured input: document id, section id, build, note. Producer is the tester. A comment with no section is discarded.
Review time stays. Filing is not a second review.
research_questions: How often is a released document wrong about a step?

already_counted.description: The documentation review is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire comments on documents that were replaced.

approvals.approved_version: risk decision the tester made for those sections

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If sections have no ids, the list is typed once and the review stays. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify deviance from standards and suggest modifications.

steps.what: Compare the program with the named standards.
Identify program deviance the comparison missed.
Suggest modifications that cite a standard clause.

loop.input: the deviance notes and the clause ids the tester named
loop.output: suggestions that cite only those clause ids
loop.check: every suggestion names a clause from the list; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a deviance with no clause is left unnamed
loop.why_not_simpler: whether the modification is worth making is the decision

steps.what: Decide which modifications would restore compliance.
Record the modifications that were accepted.

tasks.design: A comparison lists where the program already differs from named standards. The tester identifies deviance that comparison missed. Suggestions may cite only a clause the tester named. The tester decides which modifications would restore compliance. The record is that decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Deviance was noticed late, with no clause attached.
tasks.enabler_now: A clause id is a field. Whether a difference matters is not.
tasks.still_hard: A standard that does not fit this product stays a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows which deviance a customer or an auditor would notice.
tasks.altitude: The comparison is ready. Identifying the real deviance and choosing the modification stay.

reach.learn: Which clause, and what would change

evidence.claim: A suggestion that must cite a named clause can be checked. Declaring compliance cannot.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester identifies deviance and suggests. The developer modifies the program. Writing the standard is a different task.
Structured input: standard id, clause id, program area, note. Producer is the tester for the note and the standard record for the clause. A suggestion with no clause is discarded.
Identification time stays. The record does not change the program.
research_questions: How often is deviance found only at release?

already_counted.description: Identifying deviance is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire suggestions after the standard version changes.

approvals.approved_version: modifications the tester accepted for those clauses

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If clauses are not identified, the comparison is weak and the tester still reads the standard. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Do the initial debugging from files, logs and code.

steps.what: Gather configuration files and logs for the failure.
Review logs and code pieces in the initial debugging.
Draft a source note that quotes only those lines.

loop.input: the log and code lines the tester kept
loop.output: a note that quotes only those lines
loop.check: every quoted line must be one the tester kept; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a gap is marked unknown
loop.why_not_simpler: the breakdown source is the tester's determination

steps.what: Determine the breakdown source, or say unknown.
Record the source the tester determined.

tasks.design: Configuration files and logs are gathered for the failure. The tester reviews the pieces in the initial debugging. A note may quote only lines they kept. The tester determines the source, or records that it is unknown. The record does not pretend a source was found.
tasks.previous_blocker: Debugging started from memory of the log, and the source was a guess in chat.
tasks.enabler_now: A kept line can be quoted. Naming the source is not a search.
tasks.still_hard: A failure whose log does not contain the cause stays unknown until someone looks further.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows which line is a symptom and which line is the break.
tasks.altitude: Gathering the pack takes less time. The review and the determination stay. Unknown stays an allowed answer.

reach.learn: Which lines were kept, and what is still unknown

evidence.claim: Quoting kept log lines can be checked. Determining a breakdown source cannot.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester does the initial look. A deeper fix is the developer. This is not a change to the code.
Structured input: failure id, file name, log line, code line. Producer is the system for the files and the tester for the lines kept. A quote of an unkept line is discarded.
Review time stays. An unknown source is a valid record.
unknowns: Are logs kept for the failing build?
How long are configuration files retained?
research_questions: How often is a source claimed with no line cited?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the logs is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire packs after the failure is closed.

approvals.approved_version: source decision the tester made, including unknown

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If logs are gone, the pack is empty and the tester can only say unknown. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Investigation, documentation review, deviance and the first debugging stay judgements. Notes may quote only what was recorded. Unknown is an allowed source. Support receives a finding, not a guessed cause.
reach: Support sees the finding on the ticket.
A developer sees the lines that were kept.
skills_to_grow: Say unknown when the log does not show the source.
Cite a clause before suggesting a modification.
role.ambitious_version: A customer problem comes back with a finding tied to the ticket, and a risk on a document names the section.

job.title: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
